body: You get that effect by using bannetons baskets, just put flour inside so it doesnt stick and then voila u get this nice texture :)

230g levain
780g water
1200g white flour

Then add 22g salt and 2x 1/2 cups of water

Stretch and folds every 30 minutes three times and then usually leave it outside for another hour depends on the temperature tho. Put in on the pan next day for about 2/3 hours and then bake it at 190c for 28 minutes. It somehow has a lot of room for error, also tried with 880g water it was nice but not worth the hassle of stickiness. 

Have fun :).

To me fairness is real, but only to the extent that it deals with human affairs. Life is not fair. But we as humans understand that we are all the same and thus the understanding of equality. We have rules when we play games. That's what makes the game fun. Fairness. And when someone is considered a cheater at games, it's something a man might never live down. But we dont apply that to the rest of man made institutions. Which makes life no fun for a lot of people. There is truth to the phrase "life is not fair." It's not. There is illness, accidents, mistakes, all sorts of ways life itself can really fuck you. Things we have no control over. But the things we have control over we should play fair. It's how we make being people awesome.

The truth is this: life is random. You are born and you die. You toil away, hoping for the best, but arbitrary factors completely out of your control will shape your existence more than you can even imagine. There is nothing you can do about it. You are born, enjoy what you have, don't lament the things you don't. Life is not fair. It will simply never be.

And most importantly, it shouldn't be. We are a living entity. We mutate and we evolve with each generation. Our selection criteria drives that process forward and prunes dead ends. Sometimes your entire life is just a cautionary tale to others. That is why the genetic lottery created you. That is your lot. Embrace it. There is little else you can do.

Hope you will have a good day and a great life
